pages.text: Every melee weapon belongs to a $(l)weapon type$(): shortsword, greatsword, spear, warhammer, dagger and dozens more. Modded weapons are sorted into a type automatically.$(br2)The type decides how the weapon swings, how far it reaches, how wide it sweeps and how it fares in the $(l:bromax_battle:overpower/the_bar)Overpower$() system.

Some types are $(l)two-handed$(): greatswords, battleaxes, warhammers, polearms, spears, tridents, twinblades, scythes and quarterstaves, among others. A two-handed weapon in your main hand rules out off-hand attacks.$(br2)Hold $(k:sneak) over a weapon's tooltip, or set it on a $(l:bromax_battle:tools/bench)Weaponsmith's Bench$(), to see its type.
